source_title: How To Debug and Fix Ticking Entity Errors
exception_type: Ticking entity crash (-- Entity being ticked --)
raw_log:
A ticking entity error occurs when a corrupted or broken mob or block entity in your world causes the server to crash on startup.
Search for the section labelled -- Entity being ticked --.
If the section label reads -- Block entity being ticked -- instead, the culprit is a block entity (such as a chest or furnace) rather than a mob.
fix_solution:
Method 1: Kill the Entity via Console
Enter the following command, replacing the values with the entity type and coordinates from the crash report:
/kill @e[type=<entity_type>,x=<X>,y=<Y>,z=<Z>]

Method 3: Forge Config Removal (Last Resort)
Forge 1.13 and Newer: open world/serverconfig/forge-server.toml. Set removeErroringEntities to true. Set removeErroringBlockEntities to true. Save and start once, then set both back to false.
Forge 1.12.2 and Older: open config/forge.cfg, set removeErroringEntities=true and removeErroringTileEntities=true, start once then revert.

Method 4: Restore a Backup from before the error started (safest option).
